definitions.ask: Should bob keep every theme in the JSON window summary so the theme bar can show them all?
definitions.why: A gray other that hides configured themes (SASE, FIX) makes the theme bar unreliable.

choices.label: Bar shows every theme; bob-cli JSON stops collapsing themes (a ! change); Themes panel caps at 8
No bob-cli change; bar shows top five plus a gray other (19-32% of live worked time)

definitions.ask: Should each legend item show that row's time in the window, such as bob 28h 36m?
definitions.why: The bar already encodes share; the legend adds the time the bar cannot show.

choices.label: Legend shows each row's window time, like the Day strip; share goes in the tooltip
Legend shows each row's share (bob 23%), so more names fit; time goes in the tooltip

definitions.ask: Should the bars glide from the old window's proportions to the new one's on a range change?
definitions.why: Root order is stable across windows, so the glide shows how the mix shifted.

choices.label: Segments glide to new widths over 280 ms on window changes only; off under reduced motion
Bars repaint instantly, like the Day strip; no motion code
